mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Y as You
  participant A as Photo app
  participant P as Login provider
  Y->>A: Open the app
  A->>P: Send to login
  P->>Y: Ask permission
  Y->>P: Approve access
  P->>A: Return ticket
  A->>P: Swap for token
  P->>A: Give token
  A->>Y: Show your photos

nodes.explanation: You want to use a photo-printing site without creating a new password for it.
nodes.label: You the visitor

nodes.explanation: The printing site. It wants to confirm who you are and see your photos.
nodes.label: Photo app

nodes.explanation: The trusted service, such as Google, that already knows who you are.
nodes.label: Login provider

nodes.explanation: The provider's own page naming the app and listing exactly what it wants.
nodes.label: Permission screen

nodes.explanation: A limited pass the app attaches to requests for your data. It expires with time.
nodes.label: Access token

nodes.explanation: Just the agreed details, like your name and email, used to log you in.
nodes.label: Your account data

title: Logging in without sharing passwords
